definition: very old, from thousands of years ago
description: A red-haired woman in a khaki shirt and bush hat lies over a patch of desert sand and sweeps a wide brush across it, uncovering a small round coin. She brushes again and the sand falls away from a flat grey slab. The slab turns out to be a stone tablet carved with rows of hieroglyphs, and she scrapes along its edge with a pointed trowel, mouth open in amazement. Finally she stands in a sandy excavation pit beside a colossal carved pharaoh's head, with other workers climbing over the stone around it.
